PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 16, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Alvaro Castillo, Chair  Todd Lemmis, Commissioner
Michele Ware, Vice Chair  Nicholas Santos, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner  Jane Templin, Commissioner

  Planning Commission In-Person Meeting

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments
  to planningcommissioners@longbeach.gov

  Comments may also be provided in the Zoom meeting using the raise hand function or by
  pressing *9 on your phone

  Please dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 934 1096 4133
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93410964133

  Please note the Zoom meeting may encounter technical disruptions, but in-person access
  and public comment will continue to be available in accordance with the Brown Act

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54846  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54847  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, April 2, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54849  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-26-022, finding the
  proposed project exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15301 (Class 1, Existing Facilities) of the CEQA Guidelines;
  and

  Page 1 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 16, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP25-022), and adopt the proposed findings
  and conditions of approval related thereto, to allow for a restaurant to sell beer on-
  premises (Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Type 23 License - Small Beer
  Manufacturer), with 29 feet and 9 inches of linear fixed bar area in conjunction with
  food service within 500 feet of a zoning district allowing residential uses, located at
  1106 East Wardlow Road in the Community Commercial - Automobile Oriented
  (CCA) Zoning District. (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54850  Recommendation to recommend that City Council adopt an Addendum (EIRA25-
  001) to the Program Environmental Impact Report (PEIR) prepared for the General
  Plan Land Use Element and Urban Design Element (EIR03-16) (SCH No.
  2015051054) relating to a Zone Change (ZCHG24-006) and General Plan
  Amendment (GPA24-004) of a property located at 5705-5723 Lime Avenue (APN
  7127-006-917);

  Recommend that City Council adopt a City-initiated General Plan Map Amendment
  (GPA24-004), and adopt the proposed findings related thereto, to change the land
  use PlaceType and height limit of a property located at 5705-5723 Lime Avenue
  (APN 7127-006-917) from Founding and Contemporary Neighborhood (FCN)/2-
  stories to Neighborhood Serving Centers, Moderate (NSC-M)/3-stories; and

  Request City Council adopt a Zoning Map Change (ZCHG24-006), and adopt the
  proposed findings related thereto, to amend the zoning designation for a property
  at 5705-5723 Lime Avenue (APN 7127-006-917) from Low-Density Multi-family
  Residential, Small Lot (R-3-S) to Mixed Use 2, Special Use Incentives (MU-2-A).
  (District 8)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54851  Recommendation to recommend that City Council adopt an Addendum (EIRA26-
  001) to the Initial Study/Negative Declaration (IS/ND) (SCH No. 2021050034)
  prepared for the City’s Enhanced Density Bonus (ND 08-20) relating to an
  amendment to Title 21 for the Enhanced Density Bonus Program Update; and

  Recommend that City Council approve Zoning Code Amendment (ZCA26-001)
  and Local Coastal Program Amendment (LCPA26-001), and adopt the proposed
  findings related thereto, to amend Chapters 21.15, 21.21 and 21.68 of the Zoning
  Regulations to update the existing Enhanced Density Bonus to align with the
  provisions of the Inclusionary Housing Ordinance; add special bonuses for projects
  providing community benefits; and implement other procedural and implementation
  streamlining changes to the Enhanced Density Bonus Ordinance. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 2 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 16, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

6.  26-54852  Recommendation to recommend that City Council adopt an Addendum (EIRA26-
  002) to the Program Environmental Impact Report (PEIR) prepared for the General
  Plan Land Use Element and Urban Design Element (EIR 03-16) (SCH No.
  2015051054) relating to the implementation of the General Plan Land Use Element
  through an amendment to Title 21 and Title 22 of the Zoning Regulations; and

  Recommend that City Council approve a Zoning Code Amendment (ZCA24-004)
  and Local Coastal Program Amendment (LCPA24-005), and adopt the proposed
  findings related thereto, to amend Chapter 4 of the of Southeast Area Specific Plan
  (SP-2); and Title 2, Title 21, and Title 22 of the Long Beach Municipal Code
  (Zoning Ordinance) in accordance with State Law and the City’s adopted 6th Cycle
  Housing Element. The proposed code changes are intended to satisfy state
  mandates and better align the Zoning Code with the City’s General plan by
  implementing required Housing Element actions to facilitate and streamline
  housing production in the City. The amendment is composed of four (4) major
  components: (1) codifying required Housing Element Implementation actions
  related to streamlining housing development and addressing fair housing goals
  around discrimination and segregation of uses, (2) implementing provisions from
  the City’s 2023 Emergency Declaration of Housing and Homelessness, (3)
  satisfying new State Housing Law requirements around residential uses,
  definitions, and allowances citywide, and (4) changing technical language that
  clarifies the zoning code, addresses inconsistencies, and removes duplicative
  information related to housing uses and regulations. Additional minor code
  changes not specific to housing are proposed to address existing inconsistencies
  within the Zoning Code related to commercial use allowances, wireless
  telecommunications facilities, and clarifications on approval procedures.(Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
